findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; recorded affinities are removed and the label prior is equal, so no observed affinity outcome is available to score coordinate hypotheses against.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed window are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dy shows 6 sign changes with a strongly negative first rate and positive last rate. A constant rule is therefore not supported; only a time-conditioned rule over the observed support is consistent with these fits, and extrapolation is disallowed.

Several local coordinate contrasts have large first-to-last rate reversals (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z negative, last_rate_z positive; landmark_00_local_cyy similar), indicating the direction of change differs between early and late observed nodes rather than a single whole-window trend.

Branch-adjusted covariance contrasts for global centroid coordinates are not distinguishable from zero (all CIs span zero, q well above 0.5, same-sign batch fractions near 0.5), so centroid displacement is not supported as a signed favorable-versus-comparison contrast.

Shape covariance contrasts are the only branch-adjusted entries with consistent sign across batches (shape_xx and shape_yy same-sign fraction ~0.79) and negative whole-window means, but their multiplicity-adjusted q values (0.23 and 0.15) do not clear a conventional threshold, so they are candidate rather than confirmed contrasts.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned sign reversal over the observed window
hypotheses.falsifier: A constant-sign rule matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule on observed-node fit fidelity without extrapolation.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.scope: observed window [0.0,0.5], predicted endpoint world coordinates
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast that follows the observed sign reversal of landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy will track the observed selection-node contrasts better than a constant-sign rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: Additional batches or tighter multiplicity adjustment move the q values above threshold or flip the same-sign batch fraction toward 0.5.
hypotheses.observable: branch-adjusted shape_xx and shape_yy covariance contrasts
hypotheses.statement: Shape covariance contrasts (shape_xx, shape_yy) carry a weak consistent negative signed contrast that could be expressed as a coordinate reward, but only if multiplicity-adjusted support strengthens.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit, and the immediate-selection versus descendant-survival comparison is unavailable.
No current-study outcome data are available to either role, so no coordinate hypothesis can be validated against final predicted affinity here.
Turnover, increment, joint-diagnostic and regional tables were not read in this budget; within-path change versus changing cohort composition remains unassessed.
Contrast curves are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies, and no neural-module causation is implied.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Interpret the supplied evidence and answer the coordinate-design task.
